newsitem.title: USA: Enzon converts preferred shares to common.
newsitem.headline: Enzon converts preferred shares to common.

text.p: Enzon Inc said on Monday it converted its 20,000 restricted Series C preferred stock into newly issued, unrestricted Series D preferred stock, then converted the Series D shares into 1,015,228 common shares.
That leaves 109,000 shares of Series A stock, with a fixed conversion price of $11, as the only convertible preferred stock remaining in the company's capital structure, it said.
The Series C stock had been part of a March 1996 private placement to a sole holder, who has agreed not to sell his common shares for at least a year without the company's written consent.
Enzon is a biopharmaceutical company that develops therapeutics for life-threatening diseases.
